capsuleTopic.title: Exodus
capsuleTopic.subtitle: God · Moses · Pharaoh · Israel · departure · sea · memory
capsuleTopic.orientation: The Exodus begins before the sea. Its trail moves from promise and arrival into oppression, call, confrontation, departure, crossing, song, and the first roads beyond. Later Scripture keeps returning to the Event in different forms without replacing the primary witness.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow the Event from the road into Egypt through oppression, call, confrontation, departure, sea, song, and first aftermath. Then inspect how later passages remember and reuse it while keeping each later witness in its own setting.
